kalshi:CONTROLS-2028-D.question: Will the Democratic party win the Senate in 2028?
kalshi:CONTROLS-2028-D.description: If the Democratic party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

kalshi:KX2028RRUN-28-MRUB.question: Who will run for the Republican presidential nomination in 2028?
kalshi:KX2028RRUN-28-MRUB.description: If Marco Rubio announces a presidential campaign to contest the presidential nomination of the Republican party for the 2028 U.S. presidential election before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

kalshi:KX2028RRUN-28-TMAS.question: Who will run for the Republican presidential nomination in 2028?
kalshi:KX2028RRUN-28-TMAS.description: If Thomas Massie announces a presidential campaign to contest the presidential nomination of the Republican party for the 2028 U.S. presidential election before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
